title: CES 87 mungbean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: CES 87 mungbean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: CES 87 mungbean is a mungbean variety. 0.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others. Free guide.
excerpt: CES 87 is a registered mungbean variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1975. Its record notes 0.86 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Yield:** 0.86 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 0.86 t/ha trails the average of its group, 1.25. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit mungbean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant CES 87 mungbean

Munggo is ready in about two months, so it fits the gap after rice. Pick a variety that ripens its pods together, which saves picking rounds, and one rated against cercospora leaf spot and powdery mildew.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.
